canonical.title: Number of subarray sum equal k

narrative.title: Counting Settled Batches in a Netted Ledger
narrative.scenario: A payments engine records the net amount of each processing batch in order, and batches may be negative when refunds outnumber charges. A reconciliation pass must count how many contiguous runs of batches net out to an exact settlement amount. The runs may overlap and may be of any length.
narrative.inputFormat: An array nums of n integers and an integer k, the target net amount.
narrative.outputFormat: The number of contiguous subarrays of nums whose elements sum to exactly k.

testCases.explanation: The pairs of adjacent batches net to 2, and no longer run does, so the count is 2.
The run 1,2 and the single batch 3 both net to 3.

hintLevels: Level 1: The total of any run is the difference of two running prefixes, so ask how many earlier prefixes differ from the current one by exactly k.
Level 2: Sweep the ledger maintaining the running prefix and a frequency table of prefixes seen so far; each step adds the frequency of prefix minus k to the answer.
Level 3: Seed the table with prefix 0 occurring once so runs starting at the first batch are counted, and note that negative amounts mean you cannot use a sliding window here.
